pr_title: Significant terms test refactor for extendability
pr_body:
The original PR https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/75264 made some test mistakes

NXY Significant term heuristics have additional values that need to be set when testing
basicScore properties.

Additionally, previous refactor kept the abstract test class in a package that other plugins
don't have access to.

closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/75442

issue_context.title: [CI] ChiSquareTests testBasicScoreProperties failing
issue_context.body:
The failing value, -7.655210869425632E17, is very very close to zero, and arguably equal to zero given the limitations of floating point precision.  It may be best to `assert` in the core code that the value is greater than -0.1, then just return the max of zero and the calculation result so the caller never sees the very slightly negative numbers

**Build scan:**
https://gradle-enterprise.elastic.co/s/mdipouk6dxa6q/tests/:server:test/org.elasticsearch.search.aggregations.bucket.terms.heuristic.ChiSquareTests/testBasicScoreProperties

**Reproduction line:**

**Applicable branches:**

Yes
